about: The one open-pipeline definition. workspace-model.cjs (browser, workspace/lib/project.mjs) and scripts/gtm_metrics.py (brain-data.py, refresh jobs) read this file; none of them has its own copy of these rules. Change the rule here.
definition: Open pipeline is new-business deals whose HubSpot stage is not closed (the stage's isClosed metadata; hs_is_closed only when the stage is not in the catalog). Stage names never decide closed. On Hold is a separate line, not in the open totals. Renewal, customer-success and partnership pipelines are listed separately and never added in; a deal with no recorded pipeline is not new business. A past close date stays open and is flagged. Weighted = amount x HubSpot stage probability over deals that have both; deals without a probability stay in the open amount and are counted.
